title: looking for team mate/mates to make roblox games with ai
author: brynoo5
selftext:
reqs: claude max 5-20x, vision

i have several different game projects in development, ranging from card games to sword-fighting duel games, but i haven’t released any of them because i don’t think they’re good enough yet. that’s actually why i’m looking for a teammate. developing games alone is exhausting, and when i’m handling everything myself, i burn through my weekly claude limit in just two days, even on the max 5x plan. i’m looking for someone i can split the workload with and develop games alongside.

tldr: i’m not the best ai game developer out there, but i know how to write effective prompts and turn my ideas into something real.

replies.body: we will share the revenue if game makes money thats all i can offer for now

comments.author: lorekeeper32
comments.body:
Just get two 5x plans on claude. Run opus 5.5 on medium. Make sure to /compact and preserve tokens. Use asset packs from unity/fab.

Side tangent: Compared to making vr videos and 3d blender anime liveaction videos, and webtoons 5 years ago. Claude has been godsend. I can finally pursue my passion work again with ai. And have fun. Before I was just existing and now i feel like im starting to have fun. AI is the future.

I never thought i would open adobe/blender again. Was suppose to be a closed chapter in my life.

replies.author: brynoo5
replies.body: why 2 5x? is isn’t it more logical to buy 1 20x and use agents or different chats to make the game faster?

replies.author: lorekeeper32
replies.body:
Good question, i dont know either. 20x should be better but people claimed two 5x is better. I believed them on a whim and im running with that. Apparently on r/claude ppl did studies but idk if they are true.

20x you dont need to switch constantly and is much less annoying. Cuz i have to compile md and then share with the other agent.

comments.author: Stinky_You
comments.body: You should search ways to save usage, for starters start fresh chats often. I moved my 'artifacts' to local storage and claude uses waaaaay less tokens (it seems). Ask Claude what it could build to save usage and don't just build it. Make Claude inquire about it if you don't know. Today Claude built itself a way to view godot and take screenshots when I click a button or while it's coding/testing. These screenshots I can take in godot also have a little note button, they don't go to the chat (wastes usage the more you go back and forth with a screenshot in chat), they go to a separate folder, Claude resolves the issue I took a pic of and never uses the pic again (no usage, either of us can delete old screenshots). I've been using Claude like a week and a half and have no coding experience.
